extensions.scope: Storefront only: tokens scoped to html.kb (light) and html.kb[data-theme='dark'] in app/assets/css/shop.css. Admin (layouts/admin.vue) keeps packages/config/tailwind/theme.css and is out of scope.

display.purpose: H1s, caliber names, ordinal step numbers, the caliber inside the target. Condensed 68%, 760.

headline.purpose: Section, panel and form-section titles. 82% width, 700.

body.purpose: Running text, 34-46ch; leads at 1.125rem in ink grey.

tick.purpose: Ring numbers, dimension values, caliber-group labels, footer column headings. Wide 112%, uppercase, tabular.

shadows.name: overlay-scrim
shadows.note: Modal backdrop only; dark rgba(0,0,0,0.7). No box-shadows exist in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-snap
motion.use: Buttons (160ms colour, 120ms press), box-drawing geometry (360ms), sockets (220ms).

motion.name: ease-shot
motion.use: Target hit flight (520ms), ring pulse (900ms, 380ms delay), caliber clip-path swap (260ms).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.use: All transitions/animations under prefers-reduced-motion; target swaps instantly.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: gutter 1rem -> 2rem; desktop nav; hero two columns

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: sticky side panels; mobile buy bar hidden

components.name: button-hit
components.description: Primary action; the one Signal Hit per region.
components.css: :root{--kb-paper:#f3f1ea;--kb-paper-raised:#fbfaf6;--kb-paper-sunk:#e8e5da;--kb-ink:#121417;--kb-ink-2:#4a4f57;--kb-rule:#d3cec1;--kb-rule-strong:#85806f;--kb-mirror:#121417;--kb-on-mirror:#f3f1ea;--kb-on-mirror-2:#a9aeb5;--kb-hit:#c2410c;--kb-on-hit:#fff;}.ds-btn{font-family:'Archivo',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;min-height:3rem;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:2px;padding:.75rem 1.25rem;font-weight:650;font-stretch:92%;line-height:1.1;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--kb-hit);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-hit{background:var(--kb-hit);color:var(--kb-on-hit)}.ds-btn-hit:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--kb-hit) 88%,var(--kb-ink))}

components.name: chip-caliber
components.description: Caliber radio chip with ring glyph; selected fills ink and drops the hit.
components.css: :root{--kb-paper:#f3f1ea;--kb-paper-raised:#fbfaf6;--kb-paper-sunk:#e8e5da;--kb-ink:#121417;--kb-ink-2:#4a4f57;--kb-rule:#d3cec1;--kb-rule-strong:#85806f;--kb-mirror:#121417;--kb-on-mirror:#f3f1ea;--kb-on-mirror-2:#a9aeb5;--kb-hit:#c2410c;--kb-on-hit:#fff;}.ds-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem}.ds-chip{font-family:'Archivo',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;min-height:2.75rem;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--kb-rule-strong);border-radius:2px;padding:.5rem .875rem;font-weight:650;font-stretch:86%;font-size:1.0625rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;cursor:pointer;color:var(--kb-ink);transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out}.ds-chip input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-chip svg{opacity:.7}.ds-chip .ds-hit{fill:transparent}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:var(--kb-ink)}.ds-chip:has(:checked){border-color:var(--kb-ink);background:var(--kb-ink);color:var(--kb-paper)}.ds-chip:has(:checked) svg{opacity:1}.ds-chip:has(:checked) .ds-hit{fill:var(--kb-hit)}.ds-chip:has(:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--kb-hit);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: nav-header
components.description: Sticky 64px header; current link carries a 2px hit underline on the header rule.
components.css: :root{--kb-paper:#f3f1ea;--kb-paper-raised:#fbfaf6;--kb-paper-sunk:#e8e5da;--kb-ink:#121417;--kb-ink-2:#4a4f57;--kb-rule:#d3cec1;--kb-rule-strong:#85806f;--kb-mirror:#121417;--kb-on-mirror:#f3f1ea;--kb-on-mirror-2:#a9aeb5;--kb-hit:#c2410c;--kb-on-hit:#fff;}.ds-head{font-family:'Archivo',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;height:4rem;padding:0 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--kb-rule);background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--kb-paper) 90%,transparent)}.ds-mark{font-weight:760;font-stretch:68%;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--kb-ink)}.ds-mark span{color:var(--kb-ink-2)}.ds-head nav{display:flex;gap:.25rem}.ds-head a{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:2.75rem;padding:0 .75rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--kb-ink-2);text-decoration:none}.ds-head a:hover,.ds-head a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--kb-ink)}.ds-head a[aria-current=page]::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:.75rem;right:.75rem;bottom:-11px;height:2px;background:var(--kb-hit)}

components.css: :root{--kb-paper:#f3f1ea;--kb-paper-raised:#fbfaf6;--kb-paper-sunk:#e8e5da;--kb-ink:#121417;--kb-ink-2:#4a4f57;--kb-rule:#d3cec1;--kb-rule-strong:#85806f;--kb-mirror:#121417;--kb-on-mirror:#f3f1ea;--kb-on-mirror-2:#a9aeb5;--kb-hit:#c2410c;--kb-on-hit:#fff;}.ds-reg{font-family:'Archivo',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid var(--kb-ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--kb-ink)}.ds-reg li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--kb-rule)}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:4.5rem 1fr auto;column-gap:1rem;row-gap:.25rem;align-items:center;padding:1rem 0;color:var(--kb-ink);text-decoration:none}.ds-thumb{grid-row:span 2;height:3.5rem;border:1px solid var(--kb-rule);background:var(--kb-paper-sunk)}.ds-row:hover .ds-thumb{border-color:var(--kb-ink)}.ds-cal{align-self:end;font-size:2rem;font-weight:760;font-stretch:68%;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-decoration-color:var(--kb-hit);text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-row:hover .ds-cal{text-decoration-line:underline}.ds-price{grid-row:span 2;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-meta{align-self:start;font-size:.875rem;color:var(--kb-ink-2)}

components.name: mirror-buy-bar
components.description: Mobile sticky buy bar on the mirror field.

narrative.overview: The storefront is a paper shooting target. Card-stock paper is the ground, a flat black mirror is the one large colour field, thin 1px ring lines and small wide ring numbers organise everything, and a single signal-orange hit marks the choice and the primary action. Choosing a caliber is placing a shot. Downstream views are ruled registers drawn like a technical sheet with dimension lines and arrowheads. Depth is flat: rules, paper tones and the mirror field, never shadows. Tone is precise and gift-worthy, never martial.
keyCharacteristics: Card-stock paper ground, one flat black mirror field per view
Archivo variable across its width axis
2px corners; rules instead of cards; no shadows

rules.name: The One Hit Rule
rules.body: Signal orange marks exactly one thing per region: the primary action, the hit, or the current position.

rules.name: The One Mirror Rule
rules.body: The black mirror is a flat field, never a card; at most one per scroll band plus the footer.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Condensed means a caliber or a title, wide means a measurement. No second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price, quantity, count, caliber number and dimension uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with a line or a paper step, never a shadow.

dos: Do scope storefront rules to html.kb and read colours through --kb-* tokens.
Do build lists as ruled registers: heavy ink line top and bottom, 1px ring line between rows.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px; primary buttons and inputs 48px.
Do show focus as a 2px Signal Hit outline.
Do use tabular figures and the Tick style for measurements.
Do let motion describe the shot or the geometry and disable it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, decorative gradients or rounded cards.
Don't use Signal Hit for more than one action per region, or for decoration.
Don't use a second typeface, stencil or slab type, or military styling.
Don't show product photos or 3D renders that do not exist; the box drawing is the product image.
Don't apply these tokens to the admin.
